newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Yukong loan raised to US$80 mln.
newsitem.headline: Yukong loan raised to US$80 mln.

text.p: South Korean oil refiner Yukong Ltd's term loan facility has been increased to US$80 million from US$75 million, bankers said.
The three-year loan pay a margin of 39.5 basis points over the three- or six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees are 30 basis points for co-arrangers, 27.5 basis points for lead managers, and 25 basis points for managers.
Proceeds of the facility will be used for overseas investment and for refinancing existing debt.
Westdeutsche Landesbank Asia Pacific, Chase Manhattan Asia, Korea Development Bank, Sakura Finance Asia, Sumitomo Bank and Bayerische Landesbank are the arrangers.
Six financial institutions in addition to the arranger group participated in the syndication.
